'''Darryl Sarna''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2002 Joliet tournament]] on 16 February 2002 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Ops borrowed from Sichta]], according to Al Schaefer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3376">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-16-joliet-il-2-16-02-aka-dont-quit-sichtad3376/ joliet-il-2-16-02-aka-dont-quit-sichta], DeckTech (Al "MoTU" Schaefer, 16 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-16-joliet-il-2-16-02-aka-dont-quit-sichtad3376/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
